reviews.t: ingredients list is inaccurate
reviews.x: I haven't gotten to use it yet but I'm a little upset that the ingredients list is sorely incomplete. I bought this specifically for the short ingredients list to treat scalp eczema on my 6 year old niece and to find that they are misrepresenting themselves will effect my choices in the future. If I had known that the list was incomplete, I would have purchased the larger adult size.

reviews.t: Finally something good!
reviews.x: Everything was making my little one's eczema flare up and she was scratching all the time.  I discovered Exederm and it stopped.  I've told all my friends with children about it and a few have come back thanking me.  I've even started using the Exederm soap because I have been so dry this winter, and it has worked great for me.  I highly recommend this product!

reviews.t: My daughter has had dry, flaky scalp issues since ...
reviews.x: My daughter has had dry, flaky scalp issues since she was about 8 months old...chunks of skin would get combed out of her hair every time she had a bath...ever since we started using this shampoo, no more dry, flaky scalp!! This shampoo has been a true, healing God-send!

reviews.x: I was looking for a good shampoo for my daughter's excema and this product is great! She has ezcema in her hair and scratches a lot.  Since I started using this product, she doesn't scratch as much.  The only thing I don't like about the product is that it leaves her scaple very dry after so you must apply some oil to keep mositure on the scaple and hair.

reviews.t: Very good product
reviews.x: It really calms an itchy scalp for a baby! Absolutely worth the money! I'm surprised stores like Walmart or Target don't carry it...

reviews.x: It REALLY works!  I have a 3 year old who has seborrheic dermatitis on his scalp.  We have struggled with it for years, since he was an infant.  After 2 washes with this product it is gone!  I realize this sounds too good to be true but it is.  Of note before baths I would apply Moroccan oil on his scalp and let it sit for about 5min., then when I applied the shampoo I let that sit on his scalp another 5-10min. reviews.t: Price a Bit Expensive But Otherwise Happy Skin!
reviews.x: 4 stars only because the price for this is very expensive relative to the bottle size given. The product is more liquid-like than commercial shampoos so be prepared to use a lot (a good palm sized amount) to get a good lather if you have been especially dirty the day you are washing your hair with this shampoo. Otherwise a simple two teaspoon amount would suffice.  Other than the higher price, I totally love this shampoo because it doesn't have chemical ingredients that negatively over dries my

reviews.t: BURNED my toddler and me both
reviews.x: *WARNING*  this product burned both my son and I. When I tried to contact their customer service at their location in Basking Ridge, NJ (973) 615-1739 no one answered after repeated calls after 9:30 on a Tuesday morning and no one returned my calls.  I've used many many creams and lotions for eczema and I have NEVER had any sort of reaction like this.  There must be something wrong here.  It literally is still burning after I washed myself and my son off.  WORST EXPERIENCE EVER

reviews.t: must buy!
reviews.x: I definitely recommend this product for those who suffer with eczema. My son developed it when he was 4 months old, everything we tried didn't help his flare ups. Even the oinment the doctor gave us didn't help any. Only thing that sucked was that it took almost a month to get here! I couldn't order off of amazon because i live in Alaska, which is ridiculous because i live closer to Seattle! Amazing product, but snail mail for me

reviews.t: Caused my daughter to scratch her head often
reviews.x: I thought that my daughter scratched her head because her scalp was naturally dry. I didn't realize until I used this on myself and kept clawing at my head that I had been torturing my little girl. So much guilt.

reviews.t: Perfect for sensitive skin!
reviews.x: I have severe skin allergies and there are very few shampoos that I can use.  This one is a reasonable price and doesn't irritate me at all.

reviews.t: Mild shampoo
reviews.x: This shampoo is mild, but a lot is needed to clean hair, and it comes is a smallish bottle.  I only wish the price was a bit lower.

reviews.t: Highly Recommend
reviews.x: We have two children with eczema, one moderate and one mild. We have been using Exederm for well over a year now and are very happy with it. It does not irritate their scalps and (bonus) does a great job cleaning their hair. Honestly, for cleansing purposes, I prefer it to the regular baby shampoos. It is pricey, but a little goes a long way. One bottle lasts about two and a half months for our two children.

reviews.t: Reduces baby's scalp irritation
reviews.x: I was hesitant to purchase this shampoo because it wasn't tear free, but my son's eczema was getting out of control.  This shampoo really helped him reduce the irritation to his scalp.  This along with the medication his dermatologist prescribed to him have made him stop drawing blood on his scalp.  He still scratches his head, but he no longer digs his nail into his scalp and he is a much happier baby.

reviews.t: Excellent product
reviews.x: My young son has eczema and despite improvement continued to have issues on his back. We finally realized it was aggravated by his shampoo and rinsing the suds down his back.  We switched to this product with great improvement!  It cleans all sorts of messes out of hair, including PB&J.  Excellent product- clean scent, lathers nicely, rinses clean, and leaves hair soft and shiny.

reviews.t: Definitely recommend for toddler itchy scalp
reviews.x: My 3 year old suffers from excess. He starting scratching his head on/ off and it was really bothering him. I did a little Google research and saw some recommendations this.  Within 2 days the itching had started to subside. We use at every bath and haven't had an itchy scalp in months.

reviews.t: My daughter LOVED it!
reviews.x: My grandson has dermatitis, from head to toe. And not much seemed to have worked, so I ordered a lot of the Exederm products. She was so "ecstatic", she cried! Not only is he not scratching as much, but the rash has all but DISAPPEARED! Thanks seller/God bless!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the shampoo effectively calms eczema and itchy, flaky scalps, especially for children.
Several reviewers find the product expensive relative to the bottle size and note that a lot is needed to lather.
A few reviewers report negative reactions, including burning, increased scratching, or an unpleasant smell.
Some reviewers praise it for being mild and suitable for sensitive skin.
One reviewer complains that the ingredients list is incomplete.
